sources.snippet: Stellar accuracy Silero VAD has excellent results on speech detection tasks. Fast One audio chunk (30+ ms) takes less than 1ms to be processed on a single CPU thread. Using batching or GPU can also improve performance considerably. Under certain conditions ONNX may even run up to 4-5x faster. Lightweight JIT model is around two megabytes in size.
